title: Coalitional Zero-Sum Games for ${H_{\infty}}$ Leader-Following Consensus Control
summary: This paper investigates the leader-following consensus problem for a class of multi-agent systems subject to adversarial attack-like external inputs. To address this, we formulate the robust leader-following control problem as a global coalitional min-max zero-sum game using differential game theory. Specifically, the agents' control inputs form a coalition to minimize a global cost function, while the attacks form an opposing coalition to maximize it.
